name: Annelies Vermeer
bio:
Annelies discovered her passion for motorsport aesthetics while helping her father restore classic cars in their garage. This early exposure ignited a fascination with paintwork and design, leading her to pursue specialized training in automotive painting and finishing. Before joining Herberth Motorsport, Annelies honed her skills at a custom car shop, where she learned to blend artistic flair with technical precision.

At Herberth Motorsport, Annelies is responsible for ensuring that every car leaving the paint shop is a visual masterpiece. She meticulously matches colors, applies decals, and performs intricate airbrush work, all while adhering to the highest standards of quality and durability. Her keen eye for detail and ability to adapt to tight deadlines make her an invaluable asset to the team. Annelies takes pride in ensuring that the team's cars always look their best, whether on the starting grid or at a promotional event.

physical.hairStyle: Long, braided, often with colorful beads woven in
physical.description: Annelies is petite with a focused gaze and an air of quiet determination.

quirks: Always listens to Dutch trance music while working.
Has a lucky paint brush that she refuses to let anyone else use.
Keeps a small collection of miniature racing helmets on her workbench.
